title: Coroner wants Chenery death to be probed
article: British Columbia's coroner has called an inquest into the shooting death of Gerald Chenery at the hands of police last Boxing Day.
The B.C. Coroner's Service said a hearing has been tentatively scheduled for next September before coroner Stephen Fonseca and a five-member jury.
Chenery died Dec. 26 after being shot at several times during a confrontation with two Vancouver police officers on the city's rough Downtown Eastside neighbourhood.
The former Prince Rupert, B.C., resident was shot at 15 times after reportedly attacking one of the officers with two knives.

Both officers had been on the force for less than a year and the one Chenery went after was female. She said she fired at him four times, hitting him once, but he jumped on top of her and began slashing at her with his knives.
As they struggled, her partner reportedly pumped 11 shots into Chenery's back.
